learning_outcomes.text: Assimilates the basic concepts of engineering economics and their importance in engineering decisions
Expresses the role of engineering economics in the decision-making process
States what is necessary for an engineering economics study
Calculates the time value of money with engineering economics tools.
Evaluates engineering projects and investments financially and economically using engineering economics criteria
Possesses economic knowledge at the decision-making level for investment projects, in addition to technical expertise in the field of engineering.

syllabus_topics: Engineering Economics Basic Concepts, Decision Making Process in Engineering Economics Problems
Time Value of Money and Equivalence
Types of Interest and Solutions to Interest Problems
Engineering Economics Analyses, Cash Flow Diagram and Formulas Used
Net Present Value Analysis, Future Value Analysis and Annual Equivalent Amounts Analysis
Net Present Value Analysis, Future Value Analysis and Annual Equivalent Amounts Analysis
Net Present Value Analysis, Future Value Analysis and Annual Equivalent Amounts Analysis
Internal Rate of Return Analysis and External Rate of Return Analysis
Engineering Economics Analyses in the Selection of Alternative Projects
Engineering Economics Analyses in the Selection of Alternative Projects
